hypothesis: The remaining post-#2921/#2925 packed-storage retention is the per-span records themselves: 20-byte records (offset u32 + len u32 + inline 12-byte Style) where the offset is structurally derivable (the blob is contiguous: a row's spans read as running lengths from the row's own blob offset) and the style repeats (renderer-palette-bounded; the census measured at most 6 distinct styles per entry). Storing (len u32, style-id u32) 8-byte records + a per-pack style table + a RowStart{offset,first} row index should cut the retained records ~40% of the packed total (census-projected -7.55MB at the 10MiB walk tail) with byte-identical output on every path (the range-expansion oracle is the proof instrument; the per-span SGR merge-rejection stands untouched).

(ii) TRANSIENTS (class a honest negative): uncacheable (unc) visits/rows/spans = 0 across ALL walk phases on ALL THREE fixtures (a settled replay never exercises the streaming path; transcript-tail renders are 0-row; splash renders only on 2MiB walks); zero retained mass, zero churn -> no product change (the uncacheable EntryRows::Fresh path stays frozen; packing it would add per-frame cost on the streaming path for zero retention benefit).
